name: Føroya Banki P/F
summary: Føroya Banki, along with its affiliated companies, offers a comprehensive suite of banking services to both individual and corporate clients across the Faroe Islands and Greenland. Its business is structured around banking operations and non-life insurance. In addition to financial services, the company provides diverse insurance products, including property, casualty, life, disability, and critical illness coverage, as well as real estate brokerage. The institution underwent a name change from P/F BankNordik to Føroya Banki in March 2024, having been founded in 1906. Its headquarters are located in Tórshavn, Denmark.
